==Notes==
*Attacks at [[melee]] range unlike [[Tundra Giant]]s.
*Does not always spawn.  To avoid starting from the beginning you can exit to [[Dreadnought's Drift]] then [[zone]] back to respawn bosses.
*Shares spawn locations with [[Thul Boulderrain]].
